category: currency exchange rate API (daily updates on the free plan)

free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0, no card: 1.5K API requests a month with an API key, rates updated once every 24 hours.
free_tier.notes: The quota is soft-capped at 100 percent, with a little extra room. The Free plan has the standard and pair-conversion endpoints and base currency switching; historical data is for paid accounts only. The Pro plan is USD 10 a month for 30k requests, hourly updates and history from 1990. A separate keyless Open API has its own record (data-apis/exchangerate-api-open).

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 1.5K requests a month bound what a free key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://v6.exchangerate-api.com/v6/YOUR-API-KEY/latest/USD (standard) and a pair-conversion request; JSON
chaining: Daily rates for all currencies: one call a day uses about 30 of the 1.5K requests a month. The keyless Open API in data-apis/exchangerate-api-open needs no key at all.

limits.value: 1.5K API requests a month on the Free plan, soft-capped at 100 percent
no historical data on a free account; the history endpoint is for paid accounts

limits_note: Rate per minute: not stated for the keyed plan on the pages read. Bulk path: none on the free plan.
binding_note: 1.5K requests a month binds first; the rates change once a day, so about 30 requests a month cover a full daily refresh.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for an email and a password, and the key is active after email confirmation; no card for the Free plan.

reliability_note: The vendor states that any aspect of a free plan, the quota included, may change or end at any time without notice.
confidence_note: Quota, update rate, history gate, caching and sign-up fields are quoted from first-party home, docs, terms and sign-up pages. No key was created.
